view.subject: Adopted tooling: expand inScope patterns, forbid contradictory contracts, expose a running task's contract (durable across vendor refresh)
view.objective: Fix the three captain-facing tooling defects in the adopted agent-teams plugin — inScope `**` expansion, contradictory contract generation, and unreadable running-task contracts — and make the fixes durable through a vendor refresh.
acceptance: The inScope matcher honors a directory-prefix declaration such as `packages/foo/test/**` (or its documented expansion): a task declaring that pattern can complete with files under it, demonstrated by a test or a driven fixture, not by assertion

Contract generation can no longer produce a contract that lists one path in BOTH inScope and outOfScope: the defect is reproduced against the current code first, then fixed, and the fix is falsifiable

The captain (or any caller) can READ a running task's contract — the exact inScope/outOfScope/dependencies/acceptance — through an existing or new read-only surface, demonstrated by showing the contract of a live task and comparing it against what was declared
Every change to adopted code is marked in-source as a LOCAL ADAPTATION at the point of change, in the established style

The changes survive a vendor refresh: a re-apply guard (or an equivalent, explicitly stated mechanism in `scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs`) is added or extended so a `vendor-agent-teams.mjs` run cannot silently drop them, and the guard's failure mode is exercised
Existing agent-teams behavior is not regressed: the plugin's own test suite is green and a boot applying the agent-teams row shows 0 apply-crash signatures
The wave-1 defect is cited: `**` non-expansion caused declared-but-unmatched completions on t3, t4, t7 and t13, and the contract contradiction rejected a REQUIRED edit on t13

acceptance_results.criterion: The inScope matcher honors a directory-prefix declaration such as `packages/foo/test/**` (or its documented expansion): a task declaring that pattern can complete with files under it, demonstrated by a test or a driven fixture, not by assertion
acceptance_results.evidence: Pre-fix measurement: pathMatchesScope('src/a.ts','src/**')=false and classifyChangedPath('src/a.ts',['src/**'])='undeclared'. Post-fix: pathMatchesScope('packages/mpd-verif-plugin/test/a.ts','packages/mpd-verif-plugin/test/**')=true, classifyChangedPath(...)='in_scope', and the driven completion gate evaluateQualityCompletion(glob task, changedPaths=['packages/foo/test/deep/a.test.ts']).ok=true while 'packages/other/a.ts' stays rejected as undeclared. Tests: self-fix-tests/scope-glob-and-contract.test.mjs 'DEFECT 1: a declared glob covers the files beneath it' + '...completion gate accepts a glob-declared changedPath'. Negative controls: 'srcx/a.ts' vs 'src/**'=false, 'src/a.md' vs '**/*.ts'=false, 'src2/a.ts' vs 'src/*'=false. B5 regression: every wildcard-free declaration keeps exact/dir-prefix semantics (9-row table asserted).

acceptance_results.criterion: Contract generation can no longer produce a contract that lists one path in BOTH inScope and outOfScope: the defect is reproduced against the current code first, then fixed, and the fix is falsifiable
acceptance_results.evidence: Reproduced against the pre-fix shape {inScope:['AGENTS.md'],outOfScope:['AGENTS.md']} (the t13 contract): classifyChangedPath('AGENTS.md', both lists)='out_of_scope' — the gate rejected the edit the same contract's acceptance REQUIRED; the pre-fix generator produced exactly that shape because planQualityFollowUp set inScope=files and outOfScope=source.outOfScope. Fixed twice over: (a) validateCreateTask now returns ok=false with 'unsatisfiable ... in scope ... outOfScope' for that pair, for inScope=['packages/foo/**'] vs outOfScope=['packages/foo'], and for outOfScope=['**']; (b) repairScopeFromFindings generates the repair scope so a path can never land in both lists (forbidden finding dropped, unrelated carve-out preserved, new finding admitted, contradiction-free). Falsifiability: legitimate carve-outs stay accepted (packages/foo + packages/foo/vendor, glob carve-out, sibling dirs). Tests: 'DEFECT 2 reproduction', 'DEFECT 2 fix', two 'DEFECT 2 falsifiability' blocks.

acceptance_results.criterion: The captain (or any caller) can READ a running task's contract — the exact inScope/outOfScope/dependencies/acceptance — through an existing or new read-only surface, demonstrated by showing the contract of a live task and comparing it against what was declared
acceptance_results.evidence: New read-only tool agent_teams_task_contract (registered alongside status; the established 13-tool set now registers 14). test/task-contract-tool.test.mjs drives the REAL registration against a REAL team.json whose task t4 is status=in_progress and asserts every declared field round-trips exactly (in_scope=['packages/foo/test/**'], out_of_scope=['packages/foo/lib'], dependencies=['t1'], acceptance=['glob declarations are honoured'], verify=['bun test packages/foo'], attempt_id='attempt-live-1') plus the rendered block ('Task t4 [in_progress] implementation round 1 ... In scope: ... Out of scope: ... Acceptance: ... Verify: ... Dependencies: t1'). Read-only proven: team.json is byte-identical after the read, for a captain read and for a member read; unknown/blank ids are rejected. Suite: 83 pass / 0 fail.

acceptance_results.criterion: Every change to adopted code is marked in-source as a LOCAL ADAPTATION at the point of change, in the established style
acceptance_results.evidence: 7 marked regions across 2 adopted files, each bracketed by '//#region mpd-delta <id> (mpd LOCAL ADAPTATION; re-applied by scripts/patch-agent-teams-fixes.mjs)' ... '//#endregion mpd-delta <id>': scope-glob, scope-glob-core, contract-contradiction, repair-scope, repair-scope-fields (lib/quality-gates.js) and task-contract, task-contract-render (lib/tools.js). `node scripts/patch-agent-teams-fixes.mjs --check` reports 'already applied: 7 mpd delta region(s) across 2 adopted file(s)'.

acceptance_results.criterion: The changes survive a vendor refresh: a re-apply guard (or an equivalent, explicitly stated mechanism in `scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs`) is added or extended so a `vendor-agent-teams.mjs` run cannot silently drop them, and the guard's failure mode is exercised
acceptance_results.evidence: scripts/patch-agent-teams-fixes.mjs (idempotent; --check/--write/--write-registry) is invoked from scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs right after the client export bridge; the real refresh ran with DSH_HOST_NM=<dsh node_modules> and printed '[vendor-agent-teams] mpd deltas already-applied (7 region(s) across 2 adopted file(s))'. Failure mode exercised on a fixture whose deltas were dropped (303 lines removed): verify-only REFUSES with 'delta "mpd-delta scope-glob" is MISSING ... (verify-only mode)'; with the anchor line gone too it REFUSES naming the drift; --write restores 7 regions, the next pass verifies byte-identical, and the restored module still expands globs and rejects contradictions. Log: evidence/wave2/adopted-tooling/fix/guard-failure-exercise.log.
